deployments_detail.use: First two AI applications for advisor network (workflow enhancement; X-Net platform)

AI-led / AI-first client onboarding with a prospect chat ('Copilot for prospects and clients') that handles information requests during onboarding to lower attrition. Reported to have quadrupled prospect interaction, with 95% of interactions managed without any impact on Customer Care. [In-house (Fineco AI)]
deployments_detail.value: 4x increase in prospect interaction via chat; 95% of interactions managed without Customer Care impact (Jan 2026 vs Nov 2025)

deployments_detail.use: AI document-search / regulatory-research assistant for financial advisors, integrated in X-Net. Lets advisors locate regulatory references and internal circulars starting from a specific client need, speeding up bureaucratic/compliance tasks. Released to all 3,000+ advisors in the first two weeks of June 2025. [In-house (Fineco proprietary technology)]

Microsoft 365 Copilot deployed to employees for internal productivity, with company-wide training programs (Essential and Advanced generative-AI/prompting video 'pills') released to the entire Italian workforce and a dedicated M365 Copilot adoption project for a specific target group of employees. [Microsoft 365 Copilot]

AI-based English-language learning platform available to all employees, providing personalized learning paths that adapt to each person's initial proficiency level and personal interests to improve English skills. [not named]

AI Portfolio Builder integrated into the X-Net advisor platform: a tool trained on Fineco's financial logic that lets the 3,000+ financial advisors build personalized client portfolios across all asset classes (funds, ETFs), analyze existing portfolios, compare solutions, and get interactive charts/tables. Introduced summer 2025 and rolled out to the entire network. [In-house (Fineco proprietary technology)]
deployments_detail.value: 3,076 advisors as of 31 Dec 2025; AI expected to contribute 25-35% of advisory-network net-sales productivity improvement by 2029

deployments_detail.use: Fineco AI: a free virtual assistant for retail Trading Account clients that analyzes individual securities (stocks, ETFs, ETCs, ETNs) with research and analyst consensus, portfolio performance, instrument comparisons, and market news/sentiment (Reuters, Equita, Milano Finanza). Live to clients at first login; positioned as a co-pilot that does not execute trades or give MiFID advice. [Microsoft Azure (cloud/data processor, within EEA); data sources Reuters, Equita, Milano Finanza]

Brokerage Copilot: proprietary AI-driven brokerage user experience for clients that screens securities based on fundamentals and technical analysis, compares securities, provides a conversational chat for simplified securities/news search, and generates market-driven investment ideas to boost engagement and conversion. [In-house (Fineco AI)]

AI Assistant CRM for PFAs (personal financial advisors) and managers: an AI tech platform fully integrated with Fineco's data that clusters clients and prospects for new campaigns/events, generates commercial actions automatically, and surfaces alerts and an agenda of priority next-best actions. Marked 'Already live' in the March 2026 Capital Markets Day materials. [In-house (Fineco AI)]

Use of AI as an additional weapon for security/fraud protection. Deputy GM Paolo Di Grazia states AI is a technology Fineco 'already exploits in some sectors' for security, following a gradual approach; no specific system named. [not named]
